__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
__inputs.label: Prometheus
__inputs.description: Prometheus data source that scrapes the CHAKRA /metrics endpoint

description: CHAKRA load shedding: admission decisions, concurrency limit, event-loop lag, shed latency and dry-run impact.

panels.title: Shed ratio (enforce)
panels.description: Share of enforced requests (dry_run="false") that CHAKRA shed over the selected time range. Green under 1%, yellow under 5%, red above.

targets.expr:
sum(rate(chakra_requests_total{decision="shed", dry_run="false", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route", band=~"$band"}[$__range]))
/
(sum(rate(chakra_requests_total{dry_run="false", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route", band=~"$band"}[$__range])) > 0)

panels.title: Request rate
panels.description: Requests per second seen by CHAKRA across the selected instances, all decisions, enforce and dry-run.

targets.expr: sum(rate(chakra_requests_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route", band=~"$band"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Min limit vs max in-flight
panels.description: Lowest current concurrency limit across instances, next to the highest per-instance in-flight count. When in-flight reaches the limit, CHAKRA starts shedding on that instance.

targets.expr: min(chakra_concurrency_limit{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})
max(chakra_inflight_requests{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Instances in dry-run
panels.description: Number of instances currently reporting dry_run="true" decisions. Anything above zero means some pods only log what they would shed instead of enforcing.

targets.expr: count(sum by (instance) (rate(chakra_requests_total{dry_run="true", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Requests by decision
panels.description: Enforced requests per second, stacked by admission decision (admitted, degraded, shed). Dry-run traffic is in the Dry-run row.

targets.expr: sum by (decision) (rate(chakra_requests_total{dry_run="false", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route", band=~"$band"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Shed rate by band
panels.description: Enforced requests shed per second, by priority band. Sheddable should go first; shedding critical is a red flag.

targets.expr: sum by (band) (rate(chakra_requests_total{decision="shed", dry_run="false", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route", band=~"$band"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Degraded rate by band
panels.description: Enforced requests served a degraded (fallback) response per second, by priority band.

targets.expr: sum by (band) (rate(chakra_requests_total{decision="degraded", dry_run="false", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route", band=~"$band"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Shed ratio by band
panels.description: Shed requests as a share of all enforced requests in each band. Dashed lines mark 1% and 5%.

targets.expr:
sum by (band) (rate(chakra_requests_total{decision="shed", dry_run="false", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route", band=~"$band"}[$__rate_interval]))
/
(sum by (band) (rate(chakra_requests_total{dry_run="false", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route", band=~"$band"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: In-flight vs concurrency limit
panels.description: Per instance: requests in flight (solid) against the adaptive concurrency limit (dashed).

targets.expr: max by (instance) (chakra_inflight_requests{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})
max by (instance) (chakra_concurrency_limit{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Limit utilisation
panels.description: In-flight divided by concurrency limit, per instance. Near 100% means the instance is at its limit and shedding.

targets.expr:
max by (instance) (chakra_inflight_requests{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})
/
max by (instance) (chakra_concurrency_limit{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"} > 0)

panels.title: Event-loop lag
panels.description: Recent Node.js event-loop delay per instance. Sustained lag means the process is CPU-bound; dashed guides at 50 ms and 200 ms.

targets.expr: max by (instance) (chakra_event_loop_lag_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Shed latency p50 / p99 by band
panels.description: Time from request arrival to the shed response, from the histogram. p50 dashed, p99 solid. The top bucket is 100 ms, so higher quantiles read as 0.1 s.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, band) (rate(chakra_shed_latency_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", band=~"$band"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, band) (rate(chakra_shed_latency_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", band=~"$band"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Top 10 routes by shed rate
panels.description: Routes with the highest average enforced shed rate over the selected time range.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (route) (rate(chakra_requests_total{decision="shed", dry_run="false", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route", band=~"$band"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Top 10 routes: shed rate, ratio, degraded
panels.description: The same top 10 routes with their shed ratio and degraded rate over the selected time range (enforced traffic only).

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (route) (rate(chakra_requests_total{decision="shed", dry_run="false", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route", band=~"$band"}[$__range])))

(
  sum by (route) (rate(chakra_requests_total{decision="shed", dry_run="false", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route", band=~"$band"}[$__range]))
  /
  sum by (route) (rate(chakra_requests_total{dry_run="false", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route", band=~"$band"}[$__range]))
)
and on (route) topk(10, sum by (route) (rate(chakra_requests_total{decision="shed", dry_run="false", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route", band=~"$band"}[$__range])))

sum by (route) (rate(chakra_requests_total{decision="degraded", dry_run="false", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route", band=~"$band"}[$__range]))
and on (route) topk(10, sum by (route) (rate(chakra_requests_total{decision="shed", dry_run="false", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route", band=~"$band"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Would have shed, by band
panels.description: Dry-run instances (dry_run="true"): requests per second CHAKRA would have shed if enforcing. These requests were let through.

targets.expr: sum by (band) (rate(chakra_requests_total{decision="shed", dry_run="true", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route", band=~"$band"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Would have degraded, by band
panels.description: Dry-run instances: requests per second CHAKRA would have served degraded if enforcing.

targets.expr: sum by (band) (rate(chakra_requests_total{decision="degraded", dry_run="true", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route", band=~"$band"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Would-have-shed ratio by band
panels.description: Dry-run instances: share of requests in each band that would have been shed. Use it to judge readiness before enforcing.

targets.expr:
sum by (band) (rate(chakra_requests_total{decision="shed", dry_run="true", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route", band=~"$band"}[$__rate_interval]))
/
(sum by (band) (rate(chakra_requests_total{dry_run="true", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route", band=~"$band"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: Dry-run decisions by route and band
panels.description: Dry-run instances: average would-shed and would-degrade rates per route and band over the selected time range, highest first.

targets.expr: sum by (route, band) (rate(chakra_requests_total{decision="shed", dry_run="true", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route", band=~"$band"}[$__range])) > 0
sum by (route, band) (rate(chakra_requests_total{decision="degraded", dry_run="true", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route", band=~"$band"}[$__range])) > 0

(
  sum by (route, band) (rate(chakra_requests_total{decision="shed", dry_run="true", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route", band=~"$band"}[$__range]))
  /
  sum by (route, band) (rate(chakra_requests_total{dry_run="true", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route", band=~"$band"}[$__range]))
)
and on (route, band) (sum by (route, band) (rate(chakra_requests_total{decision=~"shed|degraded", dry_run="true", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route", band=~"$band"}[$__range])) > 0)

title: CHAKRA load shedding
